        "All 321 owned diff lines across five paths were read. Backup, invalid-custom-header and continue-execution strings move from filter.properties into filterEditor.ftl. Header helper declarations are replaced with ThrowFilterAlertMsg; the actual continue prompt is inlined rather than inferred removed by its old helper name.",
        "At this landing ThrowFilterAlertMsg formats synchronously, then selects the supplied message window or topmost mail window and its docShell nsIPrompt. Its returned rv does not become the dialog Alert result. BackUpFilterFile ignores the alert result and independently removes an old rulesbackup.dat then copies the file; OpenFilterList checks that backup result before truncation/reopen. Alert display and successful backup are different outcomes.",
        "ContinueExecutionPrompt returns false without a current filter, on localization failure, or when no window/docShell/dialog supplies a true confirmation. returnVal starts false and is passed to Confirm. The inspected historical parse/copy callers guard the prompt with m_msgWindow, so a false helper result alone does not prove every headless path aborts. Copy success resumes ApplyFilter; failure either ends or runs the next filter.",
        "Current accepted service uses WindowMediator's most recent window and nsIPromptService for alerts/confirmation, and its copy/parse callers no longer share every original window guard. These are later phases, not behavior authored by this Fluent change. The unchanged current failure macro still explicitly checks m_msgWindow.",
